purpose: CPU baselines and a prospective test specification; all data through the development cutoff are exploratory
universe_caveat: Hand-selected surviving tickers; staggered IPO starts, not a point-in-time investable universe
eligible_weeks: Exactly Monday through Friday; next-calendar-week last close is the target, including holiday-shortened target weeks
primary_metric: paired Brier loss reduction versus pooled training class frequencies
purge_rule: Every training target_date must precede the first test week_start
standardization: Fit mean and standard deviation on each training fold only
negative_control: Shuffle complete target-week label vectors within training, keeping tickers together; test labels remain untouched
prospective_success_rule: For the single primary model/task/comparator, the two-sided 95% four-week-block interval for paired Brier reduction must be strictly above zero; all other comparisons are secondary/exploratory
prospective_training_rule: Use the final five calendar years of available development rows with labels known before the first prospective chart week, fit once with these frozen settings, and freeze the resulting model and feature definitions for the entire prospective period
no_trading_claim: No transaction costs or executable P&L are evaluated
